integrity: An exact polynomial checker and a proof of finite quotient degree, normality and the double-plane canonical class are provided. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Geometric quotient over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field; the specified order-eight coordinate-permutation group only. Rationality and five rational singular locations in this model are explicit; no complete automorphism or arithmetic exceptional-curve classification is asserted.
title: A five-nodal degree-two del Pezzo quotient of a symmetric quartic K3 surface
